/* EBDA design-system refinements — shared laboratory surface and accessible controls */
:root{--ebda-primary:#1ca29a;--ebda-primary-dark:#116e6e;--ebda-highlight:#ffd700;--ebda-border:#d5e5df;--ebda-surface:#fff;--ebda-radius:16px;--ebda-focus:0 0 0 3px #1ca29a55;--ebda-code:#17212c}
button,select,textarea,input{max-width:100%}
button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ebda-primary);outline-offset:3px}
.interactive{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.interactive .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.interactive .topmeta{justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.interactive table{min-width:310px}
.interactive th,.interactive td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ebda-border)}
.interactive th{background:#edf7f3;color:#124d4a;text-align:left}
.interactive select,.interactive input[type=number]{min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #a7c3b8;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#20252b}
.lab-workspace{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--ebda-border);border-radius:var(--ebda-radius);background:var(--ebda-surface);box-shadow:0 10px 36px #1627230b}
.lab-workspace__header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ebda-border);background:#f1faf6}
.lab-workspace__title{font-size:16px;font-weight:850;margin:0}
.lab-workspace__badge{font-size:11px;border-radius:999px;background:#d5f2e8;color:#115e55;padding:6px 10px;font-weight:800}
.lab-workspace__body{padding:18px}
.lab-workspace__toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:12px 0}
.lab-workspace__toolbar .btn{min-height:44px}
.lab-workspace__editor-label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin:12px 0 8px}
.lab-workspace__editor{display:block;width:100%;min-height:240px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid #465a67;background:var(--ebda-code);color:#f0fcf8;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;font:14px/1.65 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;tab-size:4}
.lab-workspace__output{margin-top:12px;min-height:90px;max-height:320px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background:#f1f7f4;color:#18362d;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;font:13px/1.6 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace}
.lab-workspace__hint{font-size:13px;color:#53645d;line-height:1.55}
@media(max-width:570px){.lab-workspace__header{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.lab-workspace__body{padding:12px}.lab-workspace__editor{font-size:13px;min-height:210px}.lab-workspace__toolbar .btn{flex:1}.interactive .pill{font-size:11px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lab-workspace *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

.theory-insight{padding:24px;border-radius:19px;border:1px solid #e9dfa9;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff8de,#fffdf5);min-width:0}
.theory-insight__label,.theory-mini-label{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.45px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#116e6e}
.theory-insight h3{font-size:21px;margin:10px 0 7px}
.theory-insight p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;margin:0 0 15px}
.theory-reveal{border:0;background:#116e6e;color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:11px;font-weight:800;min-height:46px}
.theory-reveal:hover{background:#09524f}
.theory-revealed{margin-top:16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cfe6db;border-left:4px solid #1ca29a;padding:16px 19px;border-radius:12px;outline-offset:4px}
.theory-revealed p{margin:8px 0 0;color:#292d2b}
.theory-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.theory-bottom>div,.theory-focus{background:#f1faf7;border:1px solid #d9eee6;border-radius:16px;padding:18px}
.theory-bottom p{font-size:13px;margin:9px 0 0;line-height:1.65}
.theory-focus{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.theory-focus__icon{border-radius:16px;background:#d7f3e8;color:#0d736b;min-width:60px;height:60px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:37px}
.theory-focus h3{font-size:19px;margin:7px 0}
.theory-focus p{font-size:13px;margin:0}
.theory-section-heading h3{margin:7px 0 14px;font-size:21px}
.theory-path{padding:6px 0}
.theory-disclaimer{font-size:11px!important;color:#817e76!important;line-height:1.6!important;border-top:1px solid #e9e5dd;padding-top:13px;margin:0}
@media(max-width:800px){.theory-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 120px}.theory-hero__art{height:115px}.theory-orbit{height:105px;width:105px}.theory-orbit--two{height:75px;width:75px}.theory-core{font-size:45px}.theory-flow{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:530px){.theory-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0}.theory-hero__art{display:none}.theory-hero h2{font-size:26px!important}.theory-bottom{grid-template-columns:1fr}.theory-insight{padding:19px}.theory-flow__item{padding:14px}}
